_note: Two grounding hooks. UserPromptSubmit (ground-ruvnet.sh) intercepts at the INTENT level — injects a grounding directive when a prompt touches the rUv stack, reaches for a classical default (drift gate, fires even with no RuvNet mention), or is a build request. PreToolUse (hijack-ruvnet.sh) intercepts at the ACTION level — when Claude is about to Write/Edit/Bash a classical default (pinecone, pgvector, langchain, ...), it injects the rUv replacement via additionalContext WITHOUT blocking (permissionDecision:defer). stdout from these hooks is how the brain makes grounding non-optional. Every script exits 0 and is guarded with `|| true` so it can never block or error a turn.
